Package io.webagent4j.recording.replay

Class WorkflowReplayer

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.recording.replay.WorkflowReplayer
public final class WorkflowReplayer extends Object
Deterministically replays a WorkflowRecordingV2's recorded decision trace against a live Workflow: strictly validates the pair (see ReplayValidator), then reconstructs exactly what was recorded as a flattened, execution-ordered ReplayedWorkflow - never a fresh decision.

This is structural/decision replay only, not side-effect replay: replay(io.webagent4j.recording.WorkflowRecordingV2, io.webagent4j.workflow.Workflow) never evaluates a condition, never invokes an IWorkflowActionFactory, never resolves or verifies a backend target, and never performs any side effect. It is pure and stateless: the same two arguments always produce the same IReplayOutcome. A recorded CONDITIONAL step's decision is the one replayed - the non-selected branch contributes zero entries to the result, exactly as it contributed zero nodes to the source recording. Real governed-target side-effect replay (re-invoking an action against a freshly re-verified target) is a distinct, not-yet-implemented capability - see docs/recording.md for the full scope decision and what such a capability would additionally require (fresh secret input, exact-target revalidation, and this codebase's existing exactly-once governed-execution guarantees, entirely unchanged).

No interruption/deadline guard: unlike real action execution, this method performs no backend call and produces no side effect to protect, so it does not check Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted(). Its only cost is a bounded, in-memory walk of an already-decoded recording (bounded by JsonWorkflowRecordingV2Codec's own resource limits when the recording came from JSON, or by Workflow.MAX_CONDITIONAL_NESTING_DEPTH when it did not). The interruption/deadline discipline ActionExecutor and WorkflowEngine both apply around every real side effect remains exactly as strict as ever for any future side-effect-replay capability - this class has nothing to guard because it never calls anything.
